channel.title: Morocco - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Morocco, every source cited.

item.title: Morocco raises income tax exemption threshold
item.description: Starting January 1, 2027, 87% of employees will pay no income tax, with potential monthly gains of MAD 500.

item.title: Royal Air Maroc adds fifth weekly flight to Brazil
item.description: The national carrier plans daily flights to Sao Paulo by 2028 and a new route to Rio de Janeiro by end of 2027.

item.title: Moroccan Inspector General meets UN mission commander in Agadir
item.description: Lieutenant General Mohammed Berrid and Major General Jawwad Ahmed discussed mission activities and coordination.

item.title: Morocco parties get November 15 deadline for election law changes
item.description: Interior Ministry seeks proposals for 2027 local, regional, and professional elections following parliamentary vote.

item.title: Moroccan MPs question 2027 finance bill details
item.description: Lawmakers raise concerns over social aid, student grants, and electricity bill exemptions.
